# CCMAF Skills — Desktop & Mobile Apps (`ccmaf-skills-apps`)

Native and cross-platform apps: Electron, Tauri, native Windows UI (WPF/WinUI/WinForms/MAUI), Android with Kotlin and Compose, and iOS with Swift and SwiftUI.

**Audience:** Developers shipping desktop or mobile applications.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add drushegh/CCMAF---Skills
/plugin install ccmaf-skills-apps@ccmaf-skills
```

Install `ccmaf-skills-core` alongside this pack.

| Skill | What it covers | Reference docs |
